entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hello Isaac. I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought last month. I'd like to return it.

I can certainly look into that for you. First, could I get your name and order number please? ... Thank you. And just so I understand the situation correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It works fine, it's just a preference thing. To be honest, it was a bit of an impulse buy around the holidays. I've basically changed my mind about it; I find I just don't use it as much as I thought I would.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me just pull up your purchase details here and review the policy.
Sure. I did a quick search online and saw some people mentioning the resale marketplace, so I was prepared for that, but I'm hoping a direct return is still an option.

Okay, I see the order here. It looks like you received the VeloBand 31 days ago. Let's see... yes, according to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's great news. I was worried I had missed the cutoff. That's a huge relief.

Not at all, you're all set. I am sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on your account right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Perfect, that sounds very simple. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 5 to 7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
